text:
OpenAI let three safety researchers go this week, and how you read it depends on whose account you trust.

OpenAI says they mishandled sensitive information outside company procedures. The WSJ reports they shared details with an outside AI-safety group. OpenAI says its investigation found no sign of a compromise or a vulnerability.

What we don't have is the researchers' side. For now this is a company describing its own staff decision. Nothing for you to do, but worth watching.

Source: OpenAI spokesperson statement via WSJ, Oct 1
